content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

Officers working under the Central Government/ State Government/ Union Territory Administrations
Not exceeding 56 years as on the opening date of receipt of application
Offline, through proper channel/Cadre Controlling Authority

content_sections.heading: About Sports Authority of India
content_sections.text: The Sports Authority of India is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (MYAS). It is registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, and is responsible for the development and promotion of sports in the country. The notice was issued on 17 November 2026 by the Human Resources Division-II at the SAI Headquarters, J N Stadium Complex, East Gate-No. 10, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SAI is filling a total of 3 Medical Officer posts on deputation. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice lists three alternative routes to the essential education and experience for the Medical Officer post. A candidate needs to meet any one of them. The post is filled only on deputation. Applicants must be officers working under the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territory Administrations who hold either of the following: An analogous post in their parent cadre/department, OR Regular service of 5 years in Pay Level-10, Rs. 56,100-1,77,500 (Pay Band-3, Rs. 15600-39100 + Rs. 5400/- Grade Pay). The age limit is not exceeding 56 years as on the opening date of receipt of application. The notice repeats this rule in its deputation terms: the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the opening date of receipt of application. The notice does not print any age relaxation. Candidates should check the full notification for the detailed eligibility conditions of the Medical Officer post.

rows.qualification: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized University/Institution
rows.experience: 03 years of experience in the relevant field, post internship
01 year of experience in the relevant field
No separate experience is printed for this option

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Pay Matrix Level-11, Rs. 67700-208700/- (PB-3, Rs.15600-39100+Rs. 6,600/- Grade Pay), of the 7th CPC. Tenure: Initially for a period of 3 years extendable up to 5 years. Deputation terms: Deputation to SAI is as per the standard Terms and Conditions on deputation notified by DoP&T vide OM no. 06/08/2009 Estt (Pay-(II) dated 17/06/2010, as amended from time to time. Nature of appointment: On usual deputation terms, not a direct recruitment. The notice does not mention allowances beyond the pay level, and it does not name a place of posting other than the SAI Head Office that issued it.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The SAI Medical Officer selection has two stages, in this order: Interview: Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria will be called for interview. Merit list: The selection will be made on the basis of the merit list prepared by the Selection Committee and approved by the Competent Authority. The declaration in the application form also states that the curriculum vitae, supported by the documents submitted, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. The notice does not mention a written test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAI MEDICAL OFFICER
content_sections.text: Use the application format given in Annexure-I of the notice (Curriculum Vitae Proforma). The format can also be downloaded from the SAI website, www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in . Fill in the proforma and sign it. It must also be countersigned with seal by the Cadre/Appointing Authority. Have the employer complete Annexure-II, the certificate countersigned by the employer with official seal. Enclose copies of certificates in proof of age, qualifications, experience, research etc., and the other enclosures listed below. Prepare the application in duplicate, with the complete Confidential Report of the last 5 years and a certificate of Vigilance clearance from your Competent Authority. Send it through proper channel/Cadre Controlling Authority to: O/o the Director (Human Resources Division), Room No. 211, Sports Authority of India, Head Office, Gate No.10 (East Gate), Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. Make sure the application is sent on or before 17 January 2027 at 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, Annexure-I, duly completed and signed by the candidate and countersigned with seal by the Cadre/Appointing Authority. Attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 (five) years, attested on each page with seal by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or above. Integrity Certificate. Vigilance Clearance. No Major or Minor penalty certificate for the last 5 years of service. A certificate that the particulars furnished by the candidate have been verified and found correct as per service records. Cadre Clearance Certificate. Copies of certificates in proof of age, qualifications, experience and research. In Annexure-II, the employer certifies that the details are correct and that the applicant holds the required qualifications and experience. The employer also certifies that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, and that the applicant's integrity is certified. The CR Dossier in original, or attested ACR/APAR copies for five years, must be enclosed. The employer certifies either that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last five years or encloses a list of such penalties.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application must go through proper channel/Cadre Controlling Authority, not directly from the candidate. In Annexure-II, the employer certifies that if selected, the applicant will be relieved immediately. In case of any dispute, the English version of the notification will be treated as valid.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies has SAI announced?
faq.answer: The Sports Authority of India is filling 03 posts of Medical Officer on deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the SAI Medical Officer application?
faq.answer: The application must be sent through proper channel on or before 17 January 2027 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SAI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS from a recognized University/Institution with 03 years of post-internship experience in the relevant field. The alternatives are PGDSM with 01 year of experience, or PG/DNB in Sports medicine/Orthopaedics/PMR/equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SAI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 56 years as on the opening date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an SAI Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Matrix Level-11, Rs. 67700-208700/- (PB-3, Rs.15600-39100+Rs. 6,600/- Grade Pay) of the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for the SAI Medical Officer post on deputation?
faq.answer: Officers working under the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territory Administrations can apply. They must hold an analogous post in their parent cadre/department, or have 5 years' regular service in Pay Level-10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the SAI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I application in duplicate, with the required enclosures, through proper channel/Cadre Controlling Authority. Address it to O/o the Director (Human Resources Division), Room No. 211, Sports Authority of India, Head Office, Gate No.10 (East Gate), Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the SAI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for interview. Selection will be made on the basis of a merit list prepared by the Selection Committee and approved by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the SAI Medical Officer deputation?
faq.answer: The deputation is initially for a period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. It follows the DoP&T deputation terms in OM no. 06/08/2009 Estt (Pay-(II) dated 17/06/2010.

faq.question: Q10. Which certificates must be sent with the SAI Medical Officer application?
faq.answer: The application must include attested ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years and an Integrity Certificate. It also needs Vigilance Clearance, a no major or minor penalty certificate for the last 5 years, a service-record verification certificate and a Cadre Clearance Certificate.
